state_meaning: Sum of observed FIRMS detection FRP in MW; relative observed intensity, not integrated daily energy
threshold_population: All active training grid-days before predictor availability or eligibility filtering
state_rule: 0 when count=0; otherwise 1 if FRP<Q50, 2 if Q50<=FRP<Q75, 3 if FRP>=Q75
eligibility_scope: Training transitions only; all four current-state groups must pass; single-destination groups deterministic
caution: Operational safeguards; not a guarantee of statistical sufficiency or stable parameter estimates
